title: From a question to a reviewed answer
caption: Generic scheme of a RAG assistant like CompliA: the real architecture stays inside Telefónica.

user.label: Team member
user.note: Asks a question in natural language.

ui.label: Assistant
ui.note: Receives the question in a chat and takes it to search.

search.label: Search
search.note: Brings only the passages that matter for that question: that is the RAG.

llm.label: Language model
llm.note: Just one component: it writes from what was retrieved.

rules.label: Validations
rules.note: They bound what it may answer and when it must hand over to a person.

answer.label: Answer
answer.note: Reaches the screen after the validations, with its sources.

human.label: Human review
human.note: The assistant helps issue the ruling; a person confirms it.
